summary: Compassionate and detail-oriented veterinarian with over 10 years of experience in small animal medicine and surgery. Skilled in diagnosing and treating a wide range of conditions, performing surgical procedures, and educating clients on preventive care.

experience.title: Veterinarian
bullets: Examine animals to detect and determine the nature of diseases or injuries, performing comprehensive physical assessments and diagnostic testing.
Treat sick or injured animals by prescribing medication, setting bones, dressing wounds, and performing surgery, including spays, neuters, and dental extractions.
Operate diagnostic equipment such as radiographic and ultrasound equipment, and interpret resulting images to guide treatment plans.
Counsel clients about the deaths of their pets or about euthanasia decisions, providing empathetic support during difficult times.
Educate the public about diseases that can be spread from animals to humans, emphasizing zoonotic disease prevention.

experience.title: Associate Veterinarian
bullets: Inoculated animals against various diseases, such as rabies and distemper, ensuring compliance with local and state regulations.
Collected body tissue, feces, blood, urine, and other body fluids for examination and analysis, interpreting laboratory results to diagnose conditions.
Advised animal owners regarding sanitary measures, feeding, general care, medical conditions, and treatment options, improving client compliance and animal health outcomes.
Performed routine and emergency surgeries, including soft tissue procedures and orthopedic fracture repairs, with a 98% surgical success rate.

experience.title: Veterinarian
bullets: Provided preventive care services, including vaccinations, wellness exams, and nutritional counseling for a caseload of over 1,200 animals annually.
Diagnosed and treated medical conditions in small animals, utilizing critical thinking and active listening to develop effective treatment plans.
Collaborated with a team of veterinary technicians to monitor anesthesia and post-operative recovery, ensuring patient safety and comfort.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Animal Science
